title: ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents' Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.14364v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research agents achieve increasingly strong benchmark scores, yet these scores do not necessarily translate into reliable delivery in ongoing research projects. Many research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone tasks and relatively self-contained workflows in clean or curated workspaces. However, researchers ask agents to complete one step within an ongoing project, where requests depend on earlier session decisions and workspaces contain unfinished files, outdated versions, and failed attempts. We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, grounded in real session context and in-progress workspaces. ARE-bench includes 75 tasks built on agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers' own projects, spanning seven research stages, 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total. translated_title: ARE-bench：在真实研究者会话与工作空间中评测智能体研究能力的基准
translated_abstract: 研究智能体在各类基准测试中取得了越来越高的分数，但这些分数并不一定意味着它们能在进行中的研究项目里可靠地完成任务。许多研究智能体基准强调独立任务以及相对自包含的工作流，且工作空间干净或经过精心整理。然而，研究者实际要求智能体完成的是进行中项目里的某一步骤，这些请求依赖于此前会话中的决策，而且工作空间中往往包含未完成的文件、过时的版本以及失败的尝试。我们提出 ARE-bench，用以评估研究智能体能否在尊重先前决策和现有工作空间状态的前提下推进进行中的项目，其评测根植于真实的会话上下文和进行中的工作空间。ARE-bench 包含 75 个任务，这些任务基于招募来的研究者自己项目中的智能体会话和完整工作空间构建，涵盖七个研究阶段、33 项需求和 150 项子需求，共计 1,173 个二值化检查项。每个任……
tldr: ARE-bench 基于真实研究者的会话记录与进行中的工作空间构建了 75 个任务，用于评估研究智能体能否在尊重先前决策和现有工作状态的前提下推进真实研究项目。
en_tdlr: ARE-bench is a benchmark of 75 tasks built from real researcher sessions and in-progress workspaces, designed to evaluate whether research agents can advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state.
